scope: Authenticated endpoint, native maintenance and Deployment replacement using an existing PVC in one disposable Hetzner cluster.

source.binding: Chart is unchanged between historicalChartCommit and originalRecord.commit. Recorded render and historical runner configuration agree on two repositories, Secrets and PVC. No contemporaneous source/runner checksum or Git revision was recorded; exact tested working bytes cannot be asserted.

environment.serverVersionProvenance: 5ecf874bd56851f3345c1d2e1ef3dd73890c42fd:README.md records the cluster version; command dossier did not include a server-version query.

scenarios.name: HTTPS role/repository isolation and path normalization
scenarios.details: Reader/writer/admin read and native lock access allowed; reader content mutation and writer delete/overwrite denied. Unknown users, undeclared repositories, cross-repository credentials and normalized traversal writes denied; admin disposable-object removal allowed.

scenarios.name: Writer backup and byte-correct reader restores
Native lock exclusion
scenarios.details: Reader restore holds nonexclusive lock and blocks maintenance; exclusive full check blocks reader restore and writer backup with exit 11. Full check completes.

scenarios.name: Selected forget/prune
scenarios.details: Only disposable selected point removed; retained recovery point remains.

scenarios.name: Deployment replacement on retained PVC
scenarios.details: PVC UID, repository identity and full snapshot ID unchanged; restored payload SHA256 unchanged.

scenarios.name: Missing state fails without initialization
scenarios.details: Read-only init fails; missing repository not created. Original configuration restores service and byte-correct recovery.

limitations: Single-cluster endpoint/PVC proof; no cross-provider failure or full Keycloak recovery exercised.

infrastructure.billingNote: Estimate from observed provider hourly rates rounded up to whole hours, not an invoice; traffic remained inside the included allowance.

provenance.retention: Original detailed record remains in Git ancestry; recording commit is not by itself a tested-source binding.
